brief: Clear the ventilation grilles obstructed by stacked pallets left inside the compound and top up the oil level sight glass reading below the minimum mark at ambient [MG-021, MG-023, MG-025]. Because this 53-year-old asset is operating under sustained heat with warm nights and a top oil temperature running above the seasonal norm with fans called, apply the loading reductions in MG-021 [MG-021, MG-023, MG-025]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
